title: #1 AI Job Search Hack Recruiters Actually LOVE (Quick & Personal!)
description:
Stop letting AI do your job search wrong! Use this #1 AI hack to turn your career wins into resume bullets and a professional summary that actually get noticed, all while sounding like YOU.

Talk to AI like your bestie, brag about your wins, drop in the job description, and watch it create impact-driven results FAST. Bonus: Keep your own voice in there and skip sounding like an AI robot!
